dependencies: Real BHEntityPool allocation/step/refresh/release and shared VC5 rand
Owned 84-byte draw-command arena; nine header nodes, FIFO insertions preserving global bucket chain
Explicit caller-bound texture tokens and camera yaw; source-private context word in unused effect payload after verified fields
contracts: Spark creation consumes exactly eight random draws after successful allocation; no draws on allocation failure; callbacks are real source pool callbacks
Spark tick subtracts fixed lifetime amount, releases before motion on expiry, then updates position, drag/gravity, angle/width/height in original store order
Impact age tick increments fixed interval and releases at >= duration; refresh itself does not advance time
Impact refresh 00407670 consumes one random draw even if queue is full; 00407720 submits oriented quad then two ordered segments
Queue bucket mapping 0..4->1..5,5->0,6..8 unchanged, other values->0; headers form one forward chain, append uses saved tail.next, not independent circular lists
Payload fields preserve exact float/word inputs; full queue drops new commands without changing prior contents or counts
limits: Draw-command semantic selectors replace original executable draw callback pointers. This is source command production; Direct3D primitive consumers 00477640/00477710/004777c0 are not implemented or counted
Explicit texture identifiers are borrowed values, not fabricated original texture objects; actual texture/platform construction remains open
Finite PC53 moderate inputs; original x87 transcendental reduction and PC24 transitions unvalidated; malformed lifetimes/foreign entity contexts reject safely
No source-game renderer admission, no original code executed, no automated gameplay
